summary: Executed focused backend+frontend verification against investigation findings using new v2 regression tests, live auth/RBAC tests, and browser automation on preview URL. Most contract checks passed; two critical issues remain (mobile layout overflow and market-share KPI withholding edge case). Also identified legacy regression tests that now encode pre-fix semantics and should be updated, not used to revert v2 behavior.

critical.issue: When contested row has market_revenue present but my_revenue missing, summarize() can return market_revenue=0 instead of withholding (None). This can present denominator as known while numerator is unknown.

minor.issue: Old test expectation for reserved-domain refusal now receives 422 first because run_id/observed_at are required (new replay-safe contract). Test must be adapted to supply required fields before asserting reserved-domain behavior.

18+ assertions fail because they expect pre-containment semantics (measured_zero inference, looser confidence, older matching assumptions). These should be updated to v2 contract rather than treated as product regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: Severe horizontal overflow on mobile width 390px: sidebar fixed at 240px and main content keeps margin-left 240px.

issues: main_margin_left=240px on mobile causes clipped primary content

action_items: Fix mobile responsive layout: remove hardcoded main margin for small breakpoints and make sidebar collapsible/overlay on mobile.
Patch market_share.summarize() to keep market_revenue/market_units as None when numerator cohort is unknown/ineligible.
Update legacy iter79/iter80 tests to align with v2 findings (do not revert product behavior to satisfy old semantics).
Add a reserved-domain ingest test path with valid run_id/observed_at to verify both F11 contract and reserved-domain gate together.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/App.js uses static `ms-[240px]` on main; this breaks all mobile widths and reproduces the known overflow bug immediately.
backend/market_share.py summarize() still has a denominator edge-case representation mismatch (0 vs withheld None).
Several old regression tests now conflict with contained semantics; keep them from driving accidental rollback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New test coverage added for F01/F03/F04/F06/F09/F10/F12/F13/F14/F15 contracts and live auth checks. test_findings_v2_regression currently has 23 pass / 1 fail (summary withholding edge case). Live auth suite passes 6/6. UI navigation for My Products/Scanner/Market Share works on desktop. Mobile overflow still present and quantified (390px viewport => scrollWidth 1012). Legacy iter79_market_share failures are mostly contract-drift (old semantics), not evidence to rollback v2.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (mobile overflow): AppLayout keeps fixed main left margin (240px) regardless of viewport while sidebar is fixed 240px; at 390px width this guarantees horizontal overflow and clipped content. Mitigation: breakpoint-based margin reset and mobile drawer pattern. RCA-2 (summary withholding): summarize() computes `market_revenue` from contested rows while `my_measured` can be empty; representation falls back to numeric 0 instead of withheld None, creating misleading certainty. Mitigation: gate denominator output on same eligibility cohort as numerator or explicitly emit unavailable reason.
